glosses: calendar (an organized, linear system used for measuring long periods of time)
calendar (a chart or other visual aid, organized and printed or made otherwise reviewable for the purpose of tracking the progression of time)

examples.text: Nous avons un calendrier à tenir.
examples.en: We have a schedule to keep.

examples.text: Est-ce que tu as un calendrier ?
Vous avez un calendrier difficile à tenir.
examples.en: You have a difficult schedule to keep.

examples.text: J'ai regardé le calendrier au mur.
examples.en: I looked at the calendar on the wall.
